Put your static site online

Build the site on your machine, check it, then publish it to a free host with your own domain. About 30 minutes.

How to use this guide: click Mark done on each step as you finish it. Ask about anything: select text and choose ? Ask, or use ? Ask on a step. 1 · About 5 minutes

Before you start

  • Node 18 or later. Check with node -v.
  • A free account with the host. Sign up before step 3.
2 · About 10 minutes

Build and preview

1

Install the host's command-line tool You

~2 min

The command-line tool uploads your site and connects your domain.

npm install -g example-cli
example-cli login
What is a command-line tool?

A program you run by typing in the terminal instead of clicking. This one talks to the host for you, so you never upload files by hand.

2

Build the site Claude

~1 min
npm run build

This writes the finished pages to dist/.

3 · About 15 minutes

Put it online

3

Publish Both

~5 min
example-cli deploy dist/
Your site is public as soon as this finishes.
